text:
maria: FYI customer ACME sees streaming responses cut off when their client reconnects through company edge. The JSON payload is incomplete (trailing brace elided) and there is no finish_reason or final sentinel. Happens reliably when they resume a connection after auth refresh.

support-bot: Created ticket #ACME-9123 and set priority P2.

sandeep: Can you paste minimal repro steps / curl that shows the truncated tail?

maria: Repro we used (simplified):
```bash
curl -i -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" 
  -H "Accept: text/event-stream" 
  -d '{"model":"redwood-large","prompt":"stream test","stream":true}' 
  https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate
```
Observed SSE lines (excerpt):
```
data: {"id":"a1","object":"token","choices":[{"delta":{"content":"Hello"}}]}
data: {"id":"a1","object":"token","choices":[{"delta":{"content":" world"}}]}
data: {"id":"a1","object":"token","choices":[{"delta":{"content":"\n"}}]}
data: {"id":"a1","object":"token","choices":[{"delta":{"content":"!"}}]}
data: {"id":"a1","object":"token","choices":[{"delta":{"content":"..."}}
```
last line shows the JSON cut mid-object (missing closing ]} and no terminal [DONE] or finish_reason event.

jon: Do they have a proxy/edge in front? Any TLS termination or non-default buffering?

maria: Yes — customer runs Traefik v2 + corporate proxy that terminates TLS then forwards to our NLB. Their proxy does some buffering (8k default) and we see RSTs/connection resets during auth rotation. Packet capture shows backend still streaming bytes when proxy cuts the client connection.

lee: That pattern points at mid-chunk flush + client reconnect semantics. If the proxy flushes a partial chunk and then drops the TCP stream, the client sees an unterminated JSON object. Also if the client sends a resume header we currently don't have a robust idempotent resume token, so missing tail can't be recovered.

maria: Attached pcap gist: https://gist.example/pcaps/acme-trace (pcap shows FIN from proxy while server continues to emit). Also server logs: 
```
[2026-03-16T12:10:01Z] stream: send 4096 bytes
[2026-03-16T12:10:01Z] proxy: TCP FIN observed to client, upstream still open
[2026-03-16T12:10:02Z] stream: send 512 bytes (partial JSON)
```

sandeep: Immediate mitigation for customer?

maria: For now asked them to: 1) enable a short SSE heartbeat (":hb\n\n") every 2s from client to keep proxy from buffering too long; 2) increase client reconnect backoff to 3s so backend can finish flush; 3) disable aggressive proxy buffering on Traefik (set streaming response flush to on).

lee: Long-term we should: a) emit an explicit final sentinel event (e.g., data: {"type":"end","crc":"..."}) before closing; b) add a resume token so clients can request missing tail; c) add an acceptance test that simulates Traefik/NLB mid-chunk cut. I'll file engineering ticket.

eng-runtime-bot: Logged RI-789 (Streaming tail recovery). Assigned to lee. ETA: 48h for triage.

sandeep: Escalating to eng-runtime, pinging @lee and @jon. Also noting customer plan: Gold — they'll want a quicker patch.

jon: I'll add a replication test in our infra that injects mid-chunk RST and asserts final sentinel is emitted or we provide graceful resume.

maria: Customer is onboarded and will test the heartbeat workaround this afternoon. Will update ticket ACME-9123 with results. Thanks :thumbsup:

lee: ack, will start with sentinel + flush behaviour changes and report back by EOD tomorrow.

maria: Great — please also include docs guidance for clients behind buffering proxies (recommended heartbeat, reconnect backoff, and checksum sentinel).
